title: Subbly plugin marketplace
description: Lists every plugin in this repository and carries the release version. Mirrors marketplaceManifestSchema in subbly-builder (packages/plugins/src/marketplace/marketplace-manifest.ts).

$schema.description: Editor hint only. The builder strips unknown keys, so this never reaches the release.

slug.description: Identifies this marketplace. Stored in a UNIQUE column, so it must not clash with another marketplace.

version.description: The release trigger. Bump it and merge to main, or nothing ships. X.Y.Z with an optional lowercase pre-release suffix such as -beta or -beta.1.

plugins.description: Every plugin this marketplace publishes. Removing an entry archives that plugin: no new installs, and existing installs show it as no longer available.

slug.description: 1-64 lowercase alphanumerics with single - or . separators, starting and ending alphanumeric.

The plugin identity. Must equal the plugin.json name. Must stay unique across the marketplace AFTER . and - are both mapped to _, because the slug becomes an env var prefix. Must also not be claimed by another marketplace.

published.description: Set false to hide the plugin from the marketplace: only shops with the unpublished-plugins feature flag enabled in the builder admin can see and install it. Omit (or true) to publish to everyone. Flipping it is a content change, so it releases only with a version bump. Existing installations are never touched.

type.description: Only local sources exist. The plugin lives in this repository.

path.description: Directory holding the plugin, relative to the repository root. Every / separated segment must start alphanumeric. No leading /, no .., no dot-leading segment. House convention is plugins/<slug>.
